title: No local housing strategy and more than 10 dwellings: at least 20% of apartments differ in bedroom number
text: (b) Where there is no local housing strategy, developments of greater than 10 dwellings include at least 20 per cent of apartments of differing bedroom numbers.
notes: from: ch4p1 C2.1.7 (fact and 80% test). verify: '20 per cent of apartments of differing bedroom numbers' is read as at least 20% having a bedroom count different from the most common one, i.e. no bedroom count above 80%; it could instead mean 20% of each of several types.

verified.note: Page prints "at least 20 per cent of apartments of differing bedroom numbers" for "developments of greater than 10 dwellings": read as no single bedroom count above 80%; could mean 20% of each of several types.
